policy: Frozen exact Istat municipality prefix plus ANNCSU typed-street/civic linkage, with no Pistoia-specific hand tuning.
denominator_rule: All five returned ANNCSU candidates were substantively reviewed and form the precision denominator. not_found rows are coverage/recall failures, not false returned matches, and are excluded from match precision.
interpretation_limits: The Pistoia candidate population is only five rows, including one civic_access result. The 100% observed candidate precision is therefore descriptive for this frozen corpus and cannot support a national automatic-acceptance rule by itself.
production_policy_decision: Do not introduce national automatic acceptance. Keep all ANNCSU outputs candidate-by-default; retain civic_access as the strongest future acceptance candidate, but require broader multi-region evidence. Prioritise recall/fallback work because exact-linkage coverage in Pistoia is only 1.74%.
